name: Jewelry by Todd
description: Made-to-order ring settings from Jewelry by Todd, for use during Whatnot stone sales. Prices are for the setting only.
intro: Use this page during a Whatnot stone sale. It shows each handmade setting, the choices on it, and the price for the setting. The stone is separate. After the stone and the setting are chosen, the ring is made to order.
footer: To order, ask during the show. Have the style, the options, and the finger size.
